description: The app talks HTTP to its engine and sets its menus in the system menu bar. The window shows the page the engine serves on 127.0.0.1, a remote origin to Tauri, so the capability lists that address and every app command has an allow permission (build.rs). The engine's port is chosen at start, so the address cannot name it; the shell's navigation guard keeps the main window on the engine's own origin, and no other local page is ever loaded into a window this capability covers.
